cases.question: What is the deadline for returning an unused physical product?
cases.answer: The deadline for returning an unused physical product is 30 days from the date of delivery [1].

cases.question: Can I return a product that was personalized for me?
cases.answer: No, personalized items are not returnable according to the return policy [1].

cases.question: What is the express shipping price and delivery time?
cases.answer: The express shipping price is €9.90 and the delivery time is 1–2 business days [1].

cases.question: How long is the password-reset link valid?
cases.answer:
# Account access & security

To reset a forgotten password, select Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your account email. The reset link expires after 30 minutes. Check spam if the email does not arrive. Request a new link if yours has expired.

Enable two-factor authentication under Settings > Security using an authenticator app. Save the recovery codes in a secure place. If you lose access to both your authenticator and recovery codes, contact support for identity verification. Never share passwords or one-time codes with support. [1]

cases.question: How much does the Pro subscription cost per month?
cases.answer: The Pro subscription costs €29 per month, excluding applicable taxes [1].

cases.question: How long after receiving my returned item do you issue a refund?
cases.answer: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days after the warehouse receives and inspects the returned item. Bank processing may take additional time. If a refund is missing after 10 business days, contact support with your order number and return tracking number. [1]

cases.question: When will my account-data export arrive?
cases.answer: Your account-data export download link is emailed within 72 hours of requesting it and remains valid for seven days [1].

cases.question: Can an order be cancelled once it has been dispatched?
cases.answer: No, an order cannot be cancelled once it has been dispatched. Once dispatched, an order cannot be edited or cancelled. Wait for delivery and use the standard return process if eligible. For a damaged item, contact support within seven days of delivery with your order number and a photo of the damage. Support will arrange a replacement or refund after review [1].
